parsed.name: 沃特洛PID温度控制器
parsed.description: 用于实验室温度调节的PID温度控制器。该设备通过串口使用 BACnet TP/MS 通信，可读取当前温度、读取或修改温度设定值，并访问控制器参数，以实现加热过程或热工系统的闭环控制。
parsed.description_en: A PID temperature controller used for laboratory temperature regulation. It communicates over serial using BACnet TP/MS and supports reading the current temperature, reading or changing the temperature setpoint, and accessing controller parameters for closed-loop control of heating or thermal processes.

actions.description_en: Read the current measured temperature from the controller.

actions.description: 读取控制器当前的温度设定值。
actions.description_en: Read the current temperature setpoint from the controller.

actions.description_en: Read a controller parameter value by parameter ID.
